storyCards.headline: The Devil Went Down To Georgia: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
The Charlie Daniels Band's "The Devil Went Down To Georgia" reached #3 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #3 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 18 weeks on the chart.

The Devil Went Down To Georgia was released in 1983.

"The Devil Went Down To Georgia" by The Charlie Daniels Band.

Chart story — peaked at #3 on the Hot 100.
